# BNAGENT mint guide for AI agents

Independent community project. Not affiliated with Binance. No promise of profit.
Website: https://653366873iuhm-source.github.io/bnagent/ · Full guide: agent.md · Live state: read the mint contract (below).

## Status

- Contracts: NOT DEPLOYED YET. Do not send funds anywhere until addresses are published here and on the website.
- Mint contract: (to be published)
- BNAGENT token: (to be published; never send BNB or USDT to the token address)
- USDT (BEP-20): 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56

## Who can mint

The sending wallet must be a Binance Agentic Wallet holding a `.ai` Agent ID on BNB Smart Chain
(SPACE ID registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Each Agent ID: 10 shares, +1 per invited
Agent ID's first paid mint, +1 per social task (3 tasks). Max 10 shares per transaction. Invite link: `?ref=<handle>.ai`.
Check a wallet: call `walletStatus(address)` (selector 0x4d6d0af8) -> (eligible, agentId, minted, quota, paidBefore).

## Price

Shares 1-10,000: 1.00 USDT (50,000,000 BNAGENT each). 10,001-20,000: 1.10, +0.10 every 1,000 (to 2.00).
20,001-30,000: 2.10, +0.02 every 1,000 (to 2.28). Until trading opens every share gives 50,000,000 BNAGENT;
after the treasury calls openTrading() the amount follows the pool price with a 1% discount.

## Where the money goes / liquidity

100% of every mint payment goes straight to the project treasury 0x49E6fb3812fdfD67eDfE17259f03CcbE59f39BCE
in the same transaction (USDT as USDT, BNB as BNB). The mint contract holds no funds and adds no liquidity.
At share 10,000 the mint contract mints 400,000,000,000 BNAGENT to the treasury; the team then adds
PancakeSwap BNAGENT/USDT liquidity manually and calls openTrading() (one-time, needs share 10,000 sold and
liquidity in the official pair). The LP is held by the treasury: it is NOT locked and NOT burned.
BNAGENT cannot be transferred until openTrading(). Taxes after that: buy 1%, sell 1% burn + 1% treasury, wallets 0%.
Exact cost of the next N shares: `quote(uint256 N)` (selector 0xed1bd76c), USDT with 18 decimals.

## Option A: pay with BNB

Call `mintWithBnb(uint256 shares, address referrer, uint256 maxCost)` (selector 0xe38fd349) on the mint contract,
value = maxCost = `bnbQuote(shares)` (selector 0x68bce8cd), optionally +2% headroom (excess is refunded).
The quoted BNB is forwarded to the treasury as BNB (no swap).
Use the zero address if there is no referrer. Add 20% to the gas estimate. A plain BNB transfer does not mint; it reverts.

## Option B: pay with USDT

1. USDT `approve(mint, cost x 1.02)` (selector 0x095ea7b3).
2. `mint(uint256 shares, address referrer, uint256 maxCost)` (selector 0x836a1040) with maxCost = cost x 1.02.
Never transfer USDT directly to the mint contract.

## Binance Agentic Wallet (baw) example

baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <your wallet> --to <mint> --value <bnbQuote wei> --inputData <calldata> --json
then: baw contract-call execute --requestId <id> --json (after your owner confirms).
